blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Friday admitted using social media platform Discord but said its operation was not disrupted when the app was earlier banned for 24 hours. During a press briefing on Friday, PNP spokesperson PCol. Allen Rae Co said Discord is one of the various platforms that the police are using for their mode of communication, such as radio communications. “Meron po talaga tayong system na gumagamit ng Discord, depende lang po sa need of the situation kung ano ang mas ginagamit po nating platform,” Co said.
